param.name: SYS_ID
param.desc: Unique identity identifier of the vehicle inside the LIRA network mesh.

param.name: SYS_AUTOSTART
param.desc: 0: Wait for explicit GCS command, 1: Automatically execute default mission on boot.

param.name: NAV_RTL_ALT
param.desc: Altitude above takeoff point at which the vehicle will return to home destination (meters).

param.name: NAV_SPEED_MAX
param.desc: Maximum horizontal cruise speed limited during autonomous navigation mode (m/s).

param.name: SENS_GPS_HDOP_LIM
param.desc: Maximum acceptable Horizontal Dilution of Precision multiplied by 100. Lower values mean better accuracy.
